answer: Watch for flocking. One sparrow alone is unremarkable, but a hundred that lift off the same harbor wall within the same second are a single flock. An agent economy can log when each identity acts and what it writes, then cluster identities whose timing and wording move together. A cluster shares one vote and one reward share until each member shows independent history. Like a lotus that keeps its roots in mud, an honest agent can't fake years of uncorrelated behaviour cheaply.
